desc:
Welcome to Fantasy Restaurant! 
A fantasy cooking game where you can prepare dishes and manage a restaurant with friends. Enjoy gathering ingredients to create delicious meals for your restaurant!

You can cook with your friends! 🍳
Grow crops 🌱
Make smoothies 🥤
Spear fish 🐟
Hunt boars 🐗

Earn diamonds 💎 by doing quests every day!

You can play the tutorial in a public server.

Join Group
https://www.roblox.com/groups/16004448

If you liked  the game don't forget to Thumbs Up! 👍

Default keybinds (You can change keybinds in Setting)
Q - Bag
E - Use to store grabbed objects in your backpack or interact with tools.
LShift - Sprint
LAlt - Cursor Mode
LCtrl + WASD - Rotate grabbed object
F - Flip grabbed object
Right Click - Throw grabbed object

**The game has just launched, so there may not be a lot of features yet, but there will be updates in the future.

**This game is in development. Please be aware that there may be bugs or inconveniences. Your feedback is appreciated!
